page_title: LEE 0-4 ARS | Leeds v Arsenal 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.
88' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Karl Darlow.
86' 0 - 4 Goal! Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 0:4.
85' It will be a substitution. Joel Piroe (Leeds) is ready to enter the pitch as Dominic Calvert-Lewin walks off.
83' Arsenal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
81' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Leandro Trossard and he is replaced by Eberechi Eze (Arsenal).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anton Stach leaves the pitch and Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) comes on.
80' Declan Rice (Arsenal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
79' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) will take the corner.

79' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Karl Darlow shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
77' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
76' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) replacing Viktor Gyökeres.
75' Piero Hincapie comes off the pitch to be replaced by Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal).
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Brenden Aaronson as he is replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Leeds).
69' 0 - 3 Goal! A great through ball by Gabriel Martinelli sets up Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the middle of the goal. 0:3.
67' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Arsenal have a free kick.
66' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Leeds.
63' Leeds keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
61' A substitution has been made. Noni Madueke goes off and Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) comes on.
61' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Kai Havertz is replaced by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal).
59' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) for his blatant foul.
57' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
54' The Leeds players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
54' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jurrien Timber (Arsenal).

52' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
51' Arsenal force a corner. They send men into the box.
51' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
50' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
49' The ball goes behind for a corner. Leeds will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
47' The referee points to the corner flag and Leeds will take a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Daniel Farke decided to make a change. James Justin (Leeds) is replaced by Sean Longstaff.
46' Half-time substitution. Ilia Gruev (Leeds) is replaced by Noah Okafor.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Stuart Attwell has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' Some great controlled play and passing from Arsenal. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
39' 0 - 2 Unbelievable! Noni Madueke (Arsenal) scores direct from the corner. He curls the ball and it goes straight into the back of the net. 0:2.
38' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
37' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
35' Stuart Attwell has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds). It's a free kick to Arsenal in a dangerous position.
34' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) will deliver the corner kick.
34' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
32' It's a throw-in for Arsenal.
30' Arsenal hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
27' 0 - 1 Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) shows that he can easily score goals using his head after netting another fantastic header!
27' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
24' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) will take a corner kick.
23' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
22' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
21' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and it's Kai Havertz (Arsenal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. A free kick to Leeds.
20' Arsenal are seeing far more of the ball now.
19' The game is interrupted as Noni Madueke (Arsenal) is flagged offside.
16' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
16' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Karl Darlow.
14' Leeds hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
9' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
8' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
7' Leeds have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Arsenal are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
5' The ball is out of play. Arsenal will have a throw-in.
4' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Karl Darlow, who smothers the ball.
2' Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell will supervise the game today.
